jobs.description: This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: United States Dave vs. Goliath. We’re Dave. Dave is a financial app on a mission to build products that level the financial playing field. It is redefining the financial landscape by leveraging technology to create an affordable, transparent, and user-centric access to liquidity for millions of Americans. As a leading innovator in the U.S. financial services sector, Dave’s digital financial platform offers products designed to meet the credit needs of those underserved by traditional financial institutions. Dave’s offerings include its flagship ExtraCash product, providing members up to $500 within minutes. The company is on track to launch several new product offerings in 2026, including a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) option. Dave is focused on serving Americans who are financially vulnerable or living paycheck to paycheck. Dave is leading the charge in creating a new era of credit products that prioritizes speed, affordability, and accessibility, making it the go-to financial partner for those who need it most. Every credit decision Dave makes starts with data. It includes how much a member earns, when they get paid, and how they spend and repay. Our Financial Data Intelligence team builds and runs the financial data layer behind underwriting, collections, and the member experience across ExtraCash, Flex card, and the credit products we launch next. As our Senior Product Manager, Financial Data Intelligence, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for that platform. You'll turn raw bank transactions, account aggregation, and third-party data into trusted signals that help us say yes to more members and get those decisions right. You'll report to our Director of Product Management and work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Growth/Marketing, and Compliance. What you’ll build and own • Own the platform roadmap: Define and drive a multi-quarter roadmap for the financial data platform. That covers vendor integration, ingestion, normalization, storage, and access for downstream use cases. • Unlock smarter decisions: Partner with Data Science and Engineering to build data products and signals, such as income detection, cash-flow features, and repayment indicators, that improve underwriting and repayment prediction. • Expand our data advantage: Lead discovery and evaluation of new financial data sources, APIs, and partnerships beyond core bank data. Take the best of them from pilot to production. • Manage key partners: Own relationships with data aggregators and third-party data providers, balancing coverage, cost, and performance. • Raise the bar on data quality: Set standards and monitoring for data accuracy, coverage, latency, and compliance, so every team that relies on this data can trust it. • Own the numbers: Define and report on platform KPIs, and tie data improvements directly to business outcomes like approval rates, loss rates, and member retention. • Shape what's next: Drive opportunities where financial data can unlock new credit products, features, and member experiences. The impact The data you deliver sits underneath every credit decision Dave makes. Better, faster, more reliable financial data means more members get access to money when they need it, and Dave makes smarter decisions with less risk. Your work will directly shape how Dave scales credit access to millions of Americans. What we’re looking for • 5+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years in fintech, lending, or financial data products. • Strong understanding of financial data systems, such as transaction data, account aggregation, credit bureau data, or payments infrastructure. • A proven track record of building data platforms, APIs, or decisioning systems in a regulated environment. • Experience managing external vendors and data partners, from evaluation and contracting input through integration and ongoing performance management. • Strong analytical skills. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Templates & Hierarchy
jobs.description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. We're growing fast and hiring the Product talent to match. We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to join our Core Division. This role sits in the Enterprise Knowledge pillar, the team responsible for how large, multi-site customers define and govern their operational data. The pillar is building the Templating Service: the layer that lets an enterprise define a procedure, asset, work order or part once and cascade it to every site, with versioning, update policies and controlled publishing. What You'll Do You'll own the Templating Service end to end, and as it matures, the redesign of the location and asset hierarchy underneath it. • Own strategy, roadmap and execution for templates across assets, procedures, work orders and parts, taking the current design-partner alpha to GA adoption across multi-site enterprise accounts • Consolidate three overlapping configuration systems into one registry, with a migration path and deprecation sequence that strands no customer mid-move • Resolve the semantics this space is full of — update policies, publish and conflict flows, versioning, promoting existing records into templates — so teams building on top have settled rules • Run the design-partner program yourself: recurring customer sessions and prototype-driven discovery, converted into roadmap • Take the hierarchy redesign from spec to validated model — typed locations, N-level depth, functional positions that keep PM schedules alive through asset swaps — additive and non-breaking for customers on today's two-level structure About You • 10+ years in product management, including 5+ years of platform or core-product work at an enterprise SaaS company — entity models, permissioning, configuration frameworks, the foundations other products are built on, not the features on top • Deep systems thinking: you can hold a cascade/override policy or a hierarchy schema in your head, reason about cardinality and migration states, and argue the trade-offs with staff engineers as a peer • A real discovery motion — you run design-partner sessions yourself and let evidence overrule opinion • A track record sequencing multi-year foundational work while shipping customer-visible value every quarter Nice To Have • CMMS, EAM or industrial operations background • Experience migrating customers off SAP PM or Maximo-class systems Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hoo
